graphs: GPUTerrainDerivatives on the Dixie Fire DEM

formulas.ascii: slope = atan(sqrt(p^2 + q^2)) in degrees; p = zFactor * Gx / (8 * dx); q = northSign * zFactor * Gy / (8 * dy); Gx, Gy = 3x3 Sobel sums; aspect = atan2(-p, -q) in [0, 360) (-1 when flat); hillshade = max(0, normalize(-p, -q, 1) . light)

sourceLines: // Sobel responds 8 to a unit-per-pixel ramp, so Horn's derivative is raw / (8 * cell).
let northGradient = ROW_NORTH_SIGN * zFactor * rawY / (8.0 * groundCell.y);
let light = vec3<f32>(sin(azimuth) * cos(altitude), cos(azimuth) * cos(altitude), sin(altitude));
